port_probe.cases: DM reset, halt/resume, four GPR/CSR/local-memory abstract commands, four invalid system bus accesses, word writes with AW first and W first, and word read with address increment
port_probe.comparison: External port values and accepted channel counts; masked write data bits and internal state are not compared
port_probe.termination: The fixed testbench's explicit wait bounds and simulated-time watchdog, build failures, unmarked runtime failures and a missing pass marker produce FAIL. Interrupted execution and the wall-clock limit are INVALID.

comparison: Ordered normalized GPR updates extracted from the Spike and RTL instruction traces; the runner requires 2193 matches and completion before the RTL cycle limit.
